question: What meditation on the maiden form is the teacher about to transmit?
premises: The teacher addresses the listener directly.
The subject is the meditation of the maiden.
This meditation is transmitted beginning with the sages.
inference: The teacher declares to the listener the traditional meditation of the maiden as received from the sages.
uncertainties: The identity of the sages indicated by munyādyā is not specified.
plain_english: I now declare to you the meditation of the maiden, as transmitted beginning with the sages.
